prefix.description: Prefix key(s) to enter prefix mode (e.g. "ctrl+b", "f12", "esc", or an array to accept several).

new_worktree.description: Create a Git worktree from the selected workspace.

open_worktree.description: Open an existing Git worktree from the selected workspace. Unset by default.

remove_worktree.description: Delete the selected managed worktree checkout after confirmation. Unset by default.

navigate_workspace_up.description: Move workspace selection up in navigate mode.

navigate_workspace_down.description: Move workspace selection down in navigate mode.

navigate_pane_left.description: Focus the pane to the left in navigate mode. Left arrow is always an alias.

navigate_pane_down.description: Focus the pane below in navigate mode.

navigate_pane_up.description: Focus the pane above in navigate mode.

navigate_pane_right.description: Focus the pane to the right in navigate mode. Right arrow is always an alias.

detach.description: Detach the current client from its Herdr server.

reload_config.description: Reload config.toml in the running app/server.

open_notification_target.description: Focus the currently visible notification target.

previous_workspace.description: Select the previous workspace. Unset by default.

next_workspace.description: Select the next workspace. Unset by default.

previous_agent.description: Focus the previous agent shown in the agent panel. Unset by default.

next_agent.description: Focus the next agent shown in the agent panel. Unset by default.

focus_agent.description: Focus an agent by index 1-9. Unset by default.

new_tab.description: Create a new tab in the active workspace.

move_tab_previous.description: Move the active tab one position toward the front. Unset by default.

move_tab_next.description: Move the active tab one position toward the back. Unset by default.

switch_workspace.description: Switch to workspace 1-9 from prefix mode. Unset by default.

edit_scrollback.description: Open the focused pane scrollback in $EDITOR.

clear_pane.description: Clear the focused pane screen and scrollback, keeping the current cursor line and its visible soft-wrapped rows. Sends no input to the running program and does nothing on the alternate screen (for example, Vim). Unset by default; for example, clear_pane = "prefix+ctrl+k".

copy_mode.description: Enter keyboard copy mode for the focused pane.

focus_pane_left.description: Focus the pane to the left.

focus_pane_right.description: Focus the pane to the right.

swap_pane_left.description: Swap the focused pane with the pane to the left.

swap_pane_down.description: Swap the focused pane with the pane below.

swap_pane_up.description: Swap the focused pane with the pane above.

swap_pane_right.description: Swap the focused pane with the pane to the right.

last_pane.description: Focus the last focused pane across workspaces and tabs. Unset by default.

zoom.description: Toggle zoom for the focused pane. The legacy key name `fullscreen` is accepted as an alias.

resize_pane_left.description: Resize the focused pane toward the left. Unset by default.

resize_pane_down.description: Resize the focused pane downward. Unset by default.

resize_pane_up.description: Resize the focused pane upward. Unset by default.

resize_pane_right.description: Resize the focused pane toward the right. Unset by default.
